integrity.proof_type: analytic geometric and inverse-function argument with exact finite symbolic checks

scientific_limitations: Only a strict local minimum for all feasible six-disk perturbations and a global minimum within the five-spoke central-tangency subclass are asserted; unrestricted global six-disk optimality is not proved.
The optimal coefficient is first order in nine active contact gaps, not a universal packing stability coefficient.
Priority relative to incompletely accessible older finite-packing literature may require further external inspection.
title: Strict ambient perimeter stability of a six-disk hexagonal flower
